description: Search specific dates and occupancy for a known property using its propertyToken.

budget.description: Optional additional budget constraint. Clarify missing currency or basis before calling. Do not combine with legacy maxPrice/maxPriceCurrency.

amount.description: Maximum amount in the explicitly supplied currency and basis.

basis.description: Required explicit basis. Per-night means a stay-average allowance, not a ceiling on each night. Per-person means every adult and child equally; clarify other interpretations.

currency.description: Required 3-letter budget currency. Never infer from location or displayCurrency.

scope.description: PRICED_STAY compares the accommodation total including configured taxes/fees. ALL_IN requires complete mandatory charges; currently ATA cannot verify completeness and will return labeled alternatives only.

displayCurrency.description: Optional 3-letter currency for approximate traveler-facing display conversion. Native property currency remains authoritative.

propertyToken.description: Exact public propertyToken returned by discovery or property context. Never add a prefix or invent a token.

name: search_property_availability
